description: Find free ready-made PriorStates Studio Gallery apps for a need described in plain words, in English, Chinese, Spanish or Portuguese (e.g. 'split a dinner bill', 'keep my receipts for taxes', '分账', 'recibos'). Returns the best matches with what each does, a page link, a screenshot and how to open it. If nothing fits, Studio can make a new app from the description.

language.description: Language for the reply's app text and links: en, zh (Simplified Chinese), zh-hant (Traditional Chinese), es, pt. Default en (zh when the need is written in Chinese).

limit.description: How many apps at most (1-10, default 3).

need.description: What the person wants to do, in their own words.

name: find_apps
title: Find a free app for a need
